hash_contract.candidate_and_launcher: sha256 of UTF-8 file bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization
hash_contract.data: sha256 of original XLSX bytes; bundle is canonical JSON of unique data entries sorted by id
hash_contract.prompts: canonical JSON object mapping M01-M06 to each ordered prompts array
hash_contract.oracles: canonical JSON object mapping M01-M06 to each oracle object; every oracle carries oracle_version 2026-09-05.1
hash_contract.source: scripts/acceptance/release_source.py release_source_digest; current Git-filtered tracked and untracked release files; no Git writes

execution_contract.network: Only after explicit authorization, approved network-enabled execution path with DATA_AGENT_REAL_PROVIDER_NETWORK_ENABLED=1
execution_contract.preflight: Before the first real call, rerun all six cases in fresh preflight-only processes with only the exact external AUTHORIZED_BATCH_SHA256, Provider networking disabled, and socket/DNS denied. The candidate recomputes and verifies source, launcher, supervisor, data, prompts, oracles and selected case. Any failure means zero real calls. Repeat whole-input and selected-case preflight before each later case.
execution_contract.processes: One fresh OS child per case, sequential only, started through the frozen browser_process supervisor. The receipt-local parent control record, exact child command and normal exit proof are mandatory; a prior PID and finalized receipt must reconcile before the next case.
execution_contract.call_accounting: All main and auxiliary requests share each fixed case cap; sum of non-transferable caps is the hard batch cap. Unused capacity is not transferred. Persist started marker before runtime; preserve latch until process exit. Every started call consumes its slot. A cancelled call closes only with local_request_stopped proof; this does not establish remote billing or historical call completion.
execution_contract.provider_failure: A Provider transport failure closes that case after at most one bounded guard-level retry per started call, allowed only for rate_limited, network_transient or server_error classification, only while the frozen case cap still admits the retry and the failure latch is untripped (20-second backoff; the retry is a new started call consuming its own slot; litellm num_retries stays 0; any other error class fails the call without retry). quota_exhausted or credential_invalid stops the whole batch immediately; three consecutive cases closed by the same Provider error signature stop the whole batch; any other case failure closes only that case and the remaining frozen cases still run.
case_stop: upload integrity or current-session binding failure without cross-session isolation breach
unexpected confirmation requiring a new user choice
tool or workflow failure preventing subsequent state
execution_contract.case_after_stop: Only reachable read-only observations of existing state, then mark unavailable dependent steps blocked. Do not submit later prompts, confirmation responses, new exports or other mutations in the stopped case.
batch_stop: shared isolation or cross-session data exposure
unknown consumption, missing/inflight/corrupt receipts or failed accounting
previous process exit or lock not proven
global-fatal Provider failure: quota_exhausted or credential_invalid; and three consecutive cases closed by the same Provider error signature
graceful exit fails, even if later force termination succeeds
frozen supervisor mismatch or current supervised-child proof failure
execution_contract.not_batch_stop: Known static-export omissions, chart/readability defects and statistical/narrative oracle deviations do not alone stop reachable checks. All hard-stop rules take precedence.
prohibited: re-run failed or consumed cases beyond the frozen per-case retry policy (resumption requires a separately frozen and authorized batch)
modify frozen source/inputs while batch runs
reuse A01-A05R2 authorization, unused capacity or observed consumption
execution_contract.browser: Use the real browser at 1440x1000 for uploads, sends, expected confirmations, switches, refreshes and exports; no direct API chat or copied-inbox substitute. Server receipts and read-only local artifacts supplement browser evidence.
execution_contract.confirmation: At most one method_confirmation per analysis turn, only confirm_method / 按此方法继续, no free-text answers.

request_parameters.main_escalation_condition: disabled; fixed output limit, one physical attempt per logical request

execution_contract.completion: End this diagnostic batch before any further fix. Consolidate findings, then continue offline root repair and zero-Provider browser regression. Any later real call requires a new freeze and authorization.
execution_contract.diagnostic_exception: Only if user explicitly approves this proposal, permit known presentation/static-export and semantic failures to remain open while collecting real-model evidence. No evidence is promoted to pass and no safety/accounting/data-isolation checks are waived.
execution_contract.process_exit: After closing case admissions and verifying request accounting, write only the receipt-local parent stop request and observe for at most 30 seconds. If still alive, preserve exact PID/command/start-time diagnostics, stop the whole batch, and terminate only the verified owned child if needed for safety. Never call forced termination graceful and never continue to a later case.
execution_contract.authorization_identity: The user authorizes the normalized batch candidate SHA256. All derived identities are recomputed from the candidate and fail closed; legacy derived AUTHORIZED_* values are optional but must match if supplied.

allowed_writes.case_outputs: Exactly each case's writes object, including child files in its workspace and sessions.
allowed_writes.atomic_temporary_receipts: Adjacent .tmp files required for atomic receipt persistence, only within this isolation root.
allowed_writes.browser_evidence: DOM/screenshot/console evidence may be retained in the current case workspace or normal browser-tool managed evidence cache.
allowed_writes.single_reply_download: Each case may create its one single-reply Markdown through UI with a unique new filename. Do not overwrite; block this substep if new-file safety cannot be ensured.
allowed_writes.diagnostics: Process/thread/child/exit observations under the active case workspace only; no dumps of secrets or unrelated processes.
